extension.summary: Cobra EPG-first guide, player drawer and stable Multi-View presentation.
extension.description: Matched to APK 2103153. Adds a persistent preview surface, hierarchical programme guide, source-scoped cached EPG, original player controls and a docked channel drawer, themed action sheets, control lock, and stable Multi-View tile identities with per-screen diagnostics. The native Kodi engine, Infinity skin, signer and platform owners remain unchanged. This small UI package alone cannot install the new Android runtime code. Device playback and provider guide coverage require acceptance testing.
